For MorphMint C3 QA, the runtime donor is axis-normalized, anisotropically fit to the MorphMint medallion envelope, re-shaded, re-lit, and combined with the MorphMint identity insert. The donor GLB is downloaded at workflow runtime and is not committed to this repository.
